    Detailing services

    Every detail, explained

    The six jobs Sun Belt drivers actually search for — what each one includes, who it is for, and what it should cost in 2026 estimate ranges.

    Interior detailing

    Sun Belt cabins bake. UV cracks dashboards, heat sets stains, and dust and pollen work deep into cloth and carpet. An interior detail is a full reset of everything you touch and breathe.

    • Deep vacuum including under seats and in seams
    • Hot-water / steam extraction for seats and carpets
    • Leather cleaned, conditioned and UV-protected
    • Dash, console, vents and trim detailed; glass streak-free

    Price guide: included in Standard (~$278) and Premium (~$443) packages for a midsize SUV; heavy stain or odor work is quoted as an add-on.

    Exterior detailing

    Not a drive-through wash. A proper exterior detail lifts grit without grinding it into the clear coat, strips bonded contamination, and lays down real protection against Sun Belt sun.

    • Foam-cannon pre-soak and two-bucket hand wash
    • Wheels, tires, arches and door jambs degreased
    • Clay treatment to remove bonded grit and overspray
    • Wax or polymer sealant; tires and trim dressed

    Price guide: a Dallas operator lists interior/exterior details from $189; for daily commuters in Texas heat, research supports an exterior wash-and-protect cycle every 4–6 weeks.

    Full detail — interior + exterior

    The complete service in one visit: the full interior reset plus the full exterior wash, clay and protection. This is the booking to choose before selling a car, after a road trip, or twice a year to stay ahead of sun and dust damage.

    • Everything in the interior and exterior services
    • One visit, typically 3–5 hours at your home or office
    • Best value per service compared with booking separately

    Price guide: Dallas full details from $279 (My Detail Guys); a second Dallas operator lists standard full details at $269–290. Phoenix mobile full details run about $100–175.

    Which package is a “full detail”?

    On this site, Standard is the full detail for most cars — full interior plus exterior with a 3–6 month sealant. Premium adds machine polishing and a 12-month sealant for paint that has lost its gloss. If a quote for a “full detail” lands far outside the ranges on this page, ask the detailer to itemise what is included before you book.

    Selling the car? A full detail is the highest-return prep there is — and a Dallas membership at $149/month shows how locals keep daily drivers at that standard year-round.

    Ceramic coating

    A ceramic coating is a semi-permanent protective layer bonded to the paint. Under Sun Belt UV it is the strongest defence against fading and oxidation, and its hydrophobic finish means dust and grime rinse off far more easily.

    • Paint decontamination and machine polish before coating
    • Spray ceramic sealants (6–12 months) as the budget option
    • Professional coatings quoted as a range after a paint inspection

    Price guide: ceramic spray sealant add-on estimated at $95–175; professional ceramic coating estimated at $595–995 depending on paint condition and vehicle size. Ranges only — no reputable detailer guarantees a coating outcome before inspecting the paint, and neither do we.

    Pet hair removal

    Dog hair weaves itself into carpet fibres where a normal vacuum gives up. Detailers work it loose with rubber brushes, pumice tools and compressed air, then extract it — and treat the odors that come with it.

    • Full rear-seat, cargo-area and carpet hair extraction
    • Combines best with an interior or full detail
    • Odor-neutralising treatment available as an add-on

    Price guide: pet hair removal add-on estimated at $45–85 depending on build-up; heavy cases are priced in the “heavy condition” tier of the estimator.

    Fleet & rideshare detailing

    For rideshare drivers, a clean car is literally a rating: passengers score cleanliness, and a monthly interior routine protects your stars. For small fleets — sales teams, trades, delivery and rental — scheduled mobile detailing keeps vehicles presentable without losing them to a shop for a day.

    • Recurring schedules: weekly, fortnightly or monthly visits
    • On-site at your yard, depot or drivers' homes
    • Per-vehicle pricing that drops with volume — confirmed in your quote
    • Rideshare special: fast interior reset between peak periods

    Price guide: recurring plans start from the per-vehicle package averages on this page (Basic ~$158 midsize SUV) with volume terms set in the quote. The Dallas $149/month membership model shows the going shape of a monthly plan.

    For detailers: how matching will work at launch

    Right now, this page sends nothing to any detailer. Visitors build their quote pack here and send it to detailers themselves — the site does not route, distribute or forward any request. Exclusive routing is only the future launch model: when matching opens in a city, quote requests from that city will go exclusively to a small number of local mobile detailers — exclusive leads at shared-lead prices, no long contract. Those packs will arrive as the complete pack you see in the estimator: vehicle, package, condition, add-ons and the customer's own estimate range, so you would quote a warm job, not a cold name.

    Detailers in Dallas, Houston, Phoenix, Atlanta, Tampa and Charlotte: if a customer sends you their pack, that is the customer contacting you directly — nothing came through this site.

    Questions

    Mobile detailing FAQ

    How much does mobile car detailing cost in 2026?

    For a midsize SUV, 2026 mobile detailing averages are about $158 for a Basic package, $278 for Standard and $443 for Premium, based on Housecall Pro's summary of a 2026 Autodetailer.com analysis of 89 operators. Your price depends on vehicle size, condition, city and add-ons — all figures here are estimates, not fixed quotes.

    How much is a full detail in Dallas?

    A Dallas mobile operator lists full details from $279 and interior/exterior details from $189 (My Detail Guys). Another Dallas operator lists standard full details at $269–290 and premium at $468–490 (SHWASH). Treat these as starting points; your quote is confirmed after the detailer sees the vehicle.

    How much does mobile detailing cost in Phoenix?

    Phoenix mobile full details run about $100–175, with premium packages about $149–199 (Wishy Washy, May 2026). Extreme heat and dust mean Phoenix drivers often book more frequent exterior maintenance.

    What is included in a full detail?

    A full detail combines the complete interior service (deep vacuum, shampoo or steam extraction, leather cleaning and conditioning, glass and trim) with the complete exterior service (foam hand wash, clay treatment, machine polish or sealant, wheels, tires and trim). Exact inclusions vary by operator and package tier.

    Is ceramic coating worth it in the Sun Belt?

    Ceramic coating adds UV and chemical resistance that matters under Sun Belt sun, and it makes washes easier. Professional coatings are quoted as ranges after a paint inspection — no honest detailer guarantees a specific outcome before seeing the paint, so be wary of anyone who does.

    Can a detailer really remove pet hair from my car?

    Yes — detailers use rubber brushes, pumice tools, compressed air and high-suction extraction to lift embedded hair from seats and carpet. Heavy build-up takes longer, which is why pet hair removal is usually an add-on (estimate $45–85) on top of an interior or full detail.

    Do mobile detailers come to my home or office?

    Yes — that is the point of mobile detailing. The detailer brings water, power and products to your driveway, office car park or fleet yard. You just need to provide access to the vehicle and enough space to open all the doors.

    How often should I detail my car in Texas or Arizona heat?

    Heat, UV, dust and pollen are hard on paint and interiors. Research on the Texas market supports an exterior wash-and-protect cycle every 4–6 weeks for daily commuters, with a full interior detail two to four times a year. A Dallas membership example runs $149/month for a monthly detail.
